description: This file contains multiple shell functions related to managing pull request workflows, including verifying merge prerequisites, checking for mainline drift, executing merge operations, and auxiliary functions to handle repository state and communication with GitHub. It is used within a larger continuous integration or release management system for handling pull requests and merges in a git-based project.

methods.name: is_mainline_drift_critical_path_for_merge
methods.description: Function to determine whether a given file path is part of mainline drift critical paths, based on specific filename or directory patterns.

methods.name: print_file_list_with_limit
methods.description: Prints a limited list of files with their count, used for summarizing large lists.

methods.name: mainline_drift_requires_sync
methods.description: Checks whether mainline drift impacts the current merge, requiring synchronization before proceeding.

methods.name: merge_verify
methods.description: Performs comprehensive verification of the PR's readiness for merge, including check of required statuses, consistency of head SHA, and drift relevance.

methods.name: merge_run
methods.description: Main function that orchestrates the merging process of a PR, performing verification, preparing merge commit, posting comments, and cleanup.
